mostWorthwhile.text: Following the old disk material into returning gas and then central stars was worthwhile: it connected a small-scale history to the emerging shared galaxy.

leastWorthwhile.text: The central stars driving away nearby gas felt somewhat repetitive after the earlier nursery sequence.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; the final combination was the only available one and directly addressed the remaining goal.
